endpoints.host: the box you name with nable cloud connect --box https://HOST
endpoints.purpose: Your paid workspace: nable cloud connect sends the org model files (budgets.yaml among them; authority.yaml only to a box whose status lists org_file:authority.yaml in accepts, and to any other box the send is refused before anything leaves; --without-org-file NAME leaves a named file out, shown in the dry run and covered by the confirm code), the guard ledger's lines as stored, and this machine's coding-agent usage as agent_usage records (one per source, UTC day, developer, agent, model and project: agent, basis, day, developer, model, price_source, project, source, tokens by direction, unpriced_tokens and list-price-equivalent usd; no prompt, file content, path, host name or machine id), and any org_file_delete lines --delete-org-file adds (the file name alone), over HTTPS POST to /api/free-tool/connect, only with --send and --confirm set to the sha256 of the payload its dry run showed and saved; nable cloud connect --send and nable cloud status read /api/free-tool/status. nable cloud status also POSTs exactly {"person": P} (P: --as, FINOPS_GUARD_PERSON or git user.email) to /api/free-tool/standing when the box's status lists standing in reads, and keeps the answer in cloud-standing.json beside the ledger; the guard reads that file and never this host. Nothing is sent to it otherwise, and no host is built in.
endpoints.disabled_by: FINOPS_AIRGAP=1 (and nothing is sent without --send --confirm CODE, the code a dry run printed for this box)
